snippet.title: Cult Vacui | point and click announcment trailer
snippet.description:
Cult Vacui is a point-and-click with survival horror elements.
Set in the late 19th century on the remote island of Barra in Scotland.
We play an unsuspecting janitor who has been given a job opportunity to maintain the Gladstone family's summer estate. 
What we discover is that the day before our arrival, a gruesome blood ritual was performed on the island's population at the hands of a creepy cult.

wishlist on Steam!:
